title: Real-document results
set: 54 real supplier documents with simulated books (purchase register, GSTR-2B, bank)
metric_note: Every reader feeds the same code reconciler and got the same document text (no images).

readers.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
readers.sub: minimum thinking, cannot be turned off

readers.label: Ours: pd3g287
readers.sub: Qwen3-4B + LoRA, runs locally on one 16 GB GPU

defs: share of invoices whose eligible, blocked and deferred amounts are all within Rs 1 of the truth
per invoice, the right purchase-register entry, GSTR-2B row and bank payment found and the right flags raised
one overall score of ITC, matching, field extraction, totals, arithmetic, valid output and reasons
GSTIN, invoice-number and date fields where the model wrote a value that differs from the truth and the page does not show it (lower is better)
notes: The frontier readers lead on this set. Our 4B model runs on one 16 GB GPU with no document leaving the machine, and it invents fewer identity fields than Haiku 4.5 and GPT-6 luna.
Most of our lost ITC exact is misreading amounts and identity fields off the page, not judgment: with the true amounts swapped in, it goes from 61.1 to 88.6.
The 54 labels were drafted by a model and not verified by a human.
source: README.md, Results table (origin/main). Per-case ITC exact in the demo is computed live against the case's ground truth.
